node.title: FPC5 shifted-Johnson first-layout aggregate payment
node.closure: proof composition and independent exact threshold replay
node.statement: If one fixed FPC5 source/touched/defect cell has shifted-Johnson cap W L_m(q), then canonical first-layout domination bounds the complete class across all maximal source layouts by binom(M,t) W L_m(q)+M. Disjoint exact defect cells may be summed before adding M once. At n=8192 this globally pays the unique shifted cells at rates 1/2, 1/4, and 1/8 on explicit upper field slices and jointly pays defects 248 and 292 at rate 1/16, M=61 for q>=2^254; the other six shifted M=61 defects fail after touched-set aggregation even at q=2^256-1.
